correctness.rationale: For unfilled bouquet B_p of p four-cycles sharing one hub, unique earlier neighbor in a total vertex order is exactly the strong-filtration incidence-atom criterion in dimension one. Re-enumerated 24 local orders: the six non-hub incidence atoms generate exactly a hexagon L=C6 (13 including empty faces), the hub-earlier local class U is a 4-vertex path (8 faces), and hub-between local classes Wa,Wc each have three isolated points (4 faces). Independently enumerated all 7! vertex orders for p=2 and obtained 296 nonempty faces. The all-p full complex equals Z_p=L_1*...*L_p plus distinct-apex cones whose bases T_i=Wa or Wc join a U_j for any other petal j. For p≥2 each base simplicially collapses; lifting a collapse of base to its cone relative to base removes each new apex without disturbing the join Z_p, yielding a simplicial collapse to (C6)^{*p}≅S^{2p−1}. At p=1 the 8-vertex,12-edge graph has first Betti 5 (wedge five circles). The submitted check_collapse.py independently enumerates free-face pairs for p2,p3; finite tests cross-check, not replace general relative-collapse proof.
